Precision hand tools for workshops

Northwind Tools is a workshop tool manufacturer that makes calibrated torque wrenches and precision hand tools for independent vehicle repair shops. Every wrench is calibrated against a reference transducer before it leaves the factory in Pune, and each unit ships with the calibration certificate that records the measured deviation at three test points.

What we make

Our catalogue covers click-type torque wrenches from 5 to 210 newton metres, socket sets in metric and imperial sizes, and the calibration service that keeps those tools accurate after a year of workshop use. Workshops that service commercial vehicles usually pair the TW-200 wrench with our 24-piece impact socket set.

Who we serve

Most of our customers are independent garages with between two and twelve bays, plus vocational training institutes that need tools which survive being handled by a new group of students every term. We publish the full specification of every tool, including the tolerance band and the recommended recalibration interval, so a workshop can check whether a tool meets the standard its insurer requires.

Read the TW-200 torque wrench specification, compare tool prices and calibration fees, or learn how Northwind Tools was founded. Our guide to choosing a torque wrench explains which range suits which job.
